data.plain_english: Interest rates on US government bonds have climbed to their highest levels in about two decades, and that tends to weigh on share prices. The council expects health care and raw-materials companies to keep struggling. Technology companies have held up well recently, but their prices are swinging a lot, and the council is split on whether that strength will last. We have no information on the specific company you asked about, and a falling price alone does not mean a stock is cheap. This is research to help you think, not advice to buy or sell.
